`noto-sans-jp-test.otf.base64` encodes a test-only subset of Noto Sans CJK JP Regular,
© 2014–2021 Adobe, distributed under the accompanying SIL Open Font License.
It contains only U+0041 and U+65E5 plus the missing-glyph outline.

Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c/Sans/OTF/Japanese/NotoSansCJKjp-Regular.otf

It was produced with fonttools `pyftsubset` using
`--unicodes=U+0041,U+65E5 --notdef-glyph --notdef-outline`.
